name: guest-picker
title: Guest picker
description: Adults, children and infants in one popover: a stepper for each, ages as help text, and limits that explain themselves in words when they stop a button.
docs: groups is the list of kinds of guest: id, label, description, min, max, noun ({ one, other } for the summary) and countsTowardTotal (false for infants). value and onValueChange speak a number per group id, such as { adults: 2, children: 1, infants: 0 }. maxTotal caps the guests that count; the summary on the button reads "2 adults, 1 child" (formatSummary writes it differently). Minus and plus are real buttons named after the kind ("Fewer adults"); they are aria-disabled, never disabled, so they keep focus, and a stopped button points at the line that says why: under the row for a limit of its own (at least one adult), in the footer when the total is full ("The limit is 6 guests in total. Infants are not counted."). The number between them is a spin button you can type into and step with the arrow keys, Home and End. Every change is announced politely. Escape closes the panel with focus back on the button. commit="done" keeps the steps in the panel until Done is pressed, and closing any other way throws them away. open, defaultOpen (which does not take focus) and onOpenChange control the panel; labels renames every word; the button takes id and the usual button props.
